title: 第5章 她是侄儿媳妇！

content_zh:
“王爷，让雪雁来照玉她吧。”
“不需要。”
夏侯擎天断然拒绝了柳昇的提议。她是他的私有物，怎么能让其他人触碰？哪怕是女的也不行！
在温润湿毛巾的擦拭下，玉绯烟花花绿绿的小脸终于露出了她的本来面目。
她是……落入凡间的小仙女儿么？
夏侯擎天的手停在了空中，就连柳昇也闪了闪眼。
此时，玉绯烟正昏睡着，她浓密又柔软的黑发像光滑的丝绸，披散在床头，包裹着她的脸。
浓烈的乌黑和她莹白的肌肤形成了鲜明的对比，那张精致的小脸泛着珍珠般的光泽，又像笼罩了一层皎洁月色，让她看起来圣洁无比。
她的眉儿弯如新月，鼻儿挺拔俏丽，两片唇儿像含苞欲放的花朵，因为中毒，双唇泛着浅浅的粉紫色，别有一种魅惑。
虽然玉绯烟的眼睛紧闭着，可是夏侯擎天知道它们睁开会有多美。他早就该想到，她有着一双比珍宝还要璀璨的眼睛，人又会差哪儿去呢！
这双眼乌黑明亮，宛若星辰。
风起云涌时，雾霭沉沉，像迷一样捉摸不透；风轻云淡时，清澈透亮，明晃晃能映入人心，简直是他见过的最美的物件……
夏侯擎天伸手抚上玉绯烟的眉眼，唇角微微上钩。
看来他赚大了！
夏侯擎天的动作，再次刷新了柳晟对自家王爷的认知。若不是因为他身上的气场依旧，柳晟甚至会怀疑王爷被人掉包了。
不近女色的王爷也有这么温柔伺候女人的时候？
离谱，太离谱了！
虽然躺着的少女非常稚嫩，还算不上女人，可她毕竟是第一个让夏侯擎天破例的异性啊！
察觉到柳昇也在打量着玉绯烟，夏侯擎天有些憋气，目光渐渐变得不善。不管柳昇是什么眼神，盯着他的猫儿看，就是罪过！
“爷要给她上药，你不回避？”

听出夏侯擎天声音中的不悦，柳昇眼里闪过一丝惊诧，“王爷，男女授受不亲！事关小姐清誉，上药还是让雪雁来吧！”
“一个小娃儿，毛还没长齐，算得上是女人么！”
夏侯擎天脸上带着薄薄的红霞，脑子里的画面却是温泉边那个叠加在自己身上的娇软小妮子——
“王爷，毛有没有长齐你怎么知道……”
柳昇话没说完，夏侯擎天身上突然爆发的戾气就让他乖乖闭上嘴巴，紧接而来的一股劲道掌风更是毫不客气地将他扫出门外。
“咳咳！”柳昇揉了揉沉闷胸口，“王爷，你偷袭！”
屋里，夏侯擎天将玉绯烟剥了个干干净净。
在看到她雪白肌肤上纵横交错的猩红鞭痕后，他眼里的漩涡越来越沉重。
不管伤她的是谁，下手可真狠，像有深仇大恨似的！
一道、两道、三道……
夏侯擎天一边给玉绯烟的鞭痕涂抹药膏，一边数着，最后数下来，竟有整整三十七道鞭伤，有好几处更是皮开肉绽，血肉模糊。
这该有多疼！
她这样娇娇嫩嫩，像含苞欲放的花骨朵，哪里经得住这些苦！
到底……是谁伤了她？！
见昏睡的玉绯烟不断皱眉，一副快要疼哭了的模样，夏侯擎天的手愈发小心翼翼，脸色也愈发难看。
想到玉绯烟咬牙忍着痛，一身鞭伤一声不吭的，还倔强地为自己挡下那些西越国的弩箭，夏侯擎天抿了抿唇，浓密的睫毛挡住了眼底的浅浅温情。
不愧是爷看中的人，没辜负爷的信任！
只是，性子太拧巴了。
不过没关系，爷有时间来调教！
“爷在！别怕——”捏了捏玉绯烟的小鼻子，夏侯擎天给她盖上了被子。

等夏侯擎天洗澡换了干净的衣服，一份关于玉绯烟的资料已经放在了他的书桌上。
玉绯烟，忠义侯府二小姐。
刚看到第一句话，夏侯擎天的眉头就忍不住皱了起来。
若她是别的出身，他还能直接登门索要，可她是忠义侯府的千金，强留她在身边稍稍有些难度！
忠义侯玉惊雷骁勇善战，战功赫赫，他膝下三子全部是精忠报国的勇将。
长子玉千寻战死沙场，二子玉千寒在战场失踪，三子玉千血被敌将废了气魄，玉家可谓一门忠烈。
如果小猫儿真的是玉千寻的女儿，忠义侯府的嫡小姐，即便他贵为王爷，也不能掳了她……
往下看，记载了玉绯烟从小到大的事情。
痴傻？五岁的测试结果显示她的武力值为零，是个无法凝聚玄力，一辈子都不能习武的废物？七岁的一场大病，让她永远只有七岁孩童的智商，是个不折不扣的傻子？

content_en:
"My lord, let Xue Yan take care of her."
"No need."
Xiahou Qingtian flatly rejected Liu Sheng's proposal. She was his private property, how could she let anyone else touch her? Not even if it’s a woman!
Wiped with a warm wet towel, Yufei Yanhua's colorful little face finally revealed her true colors.
Is she... a fairy daughter who fell into the mortal world?
Xiahou Qingtian's hand stopped in the air, and even Liu Sheng blinked.
At this time, Yu Feiyan was falling asleep. Her thick and soft black hair was like smooth silk, spread on the bedside and wrapped around her face.
The intense blackness formed a sharp contrast with her fair skin. Her delicate little face glowed with a pearl-like luster, and seemed to be shrouded in a layer of bright moonlight, making her look extremely holy.
Her eyebrows are as curved as a crescent moon, her nose is straight and pretty, and her lips are like budding flowers. Due to the poison, her lips are glowing with a light pink-purple color, which has a unique charm.
Although Yu Feiyan's eyes were closed tightly, Xiahou Qingtian knew how beautiful they would be when they were opened. He should have thought a long time ago that she has a pair of eyes that are more dazzling than treasures, how could she be so different!
These eyes are black and bright, like stars.
When the wind was blowing and the clouds were surging, the mist was heavy and elusive like a mystery; when the wind was light and the clouds were light, it was clear and translucent, so bright that it caught people's hearts. It was simply the most beautiful thing he had ever seen...
Xiahou Qingtian stretched out his hand to caress Yu Feiyan's eyebrows, and the corners of his lips curled up slightly.
Looks like he made a lot of money!
Xiahou Qingtian's actions once again refreshed Liu Sheng's understanding of his prince. If it weren't for the fact that his aura remained the same, Liu Sheng would even suspect that the prince had been tricked.
How could a prince who is not a womanizer be so gentle to a woman?
Outrageous, too outrageous!
Although the girl lying down is very immature and not even considered a woman, she is the first person of the opposite sex to make Xiahou Qingtian an exception!
Realizing that Liu Sheng was also sizing up Yu Feiyan, Xiahou Qingtian felt a little suffocated and his eyes gradually became unkind. No matter what Liu Sheng's eyes are, staring at his cat is a sin!
"I want to give her medicine, why don't you avoid it?"
Hearing the displeasure in Xia Hou Qingtian's voice, a flash of surprise flashed in Liu Sheng's eyes, "Your Majesty, men and women cannot be intimate! It is about the reputation of the young lady. Let Xue Yan do the medicine!"
"How can a little baby be considered a woman if her hair hasn't even grown yet?"
There was a thin blush on Xiahou Qingtian's face, but the picture in his mind was of the delicate little girl superimposed on his body by the hot spring——
"My lord, how do you know whether your hair has grown straight..."
Before Liu Sheng finished speaking, Xiahou Qingtian's sudden burst of anger made him shut up obediently, and then a powerful palm wind swept him out of the door unceremoniously.
"Ahem!" Liu Sheng rubbed his dull chest, "My lord, you sneak attack!"
In the room, Xiahou Qingtian peeled off Jade Feiyan completely.
After seeing the crisscross scarlet whip marks on her snow-white skin, the whirlpool in his eyes became heavier and heavier.
No matter who hurt her, he was so cruel, as if he had a deep hatred!
One way, two ways, three ways...
Xiahou Qingtian counted the ointment while applying ointment to Yu Feiyan's whip marks. At last count, there were thirty-seven whip wounds, and in several places the skin was torn and bloody.
How painful it must be!
She is so delicate and delicate, like a flower in bud, how can she withstand all these hardships!
In the end...who hurt her? !
Seeing the sleeping Yu Feiyan frowning continuously and looking like she was about to cry in pain, Xiahou Qingtian's hands became more cautious and his face became more and more ugly.
Thinking of Yu Feiyan gritting her teeth and enduring the pain, not saying a word despite being whipped, and stubbornly blocking the crossbow arrows from the West Yue Kingdom for herself, Xiahou Qingtian pursed his lips, and his thick eyelashes blocked the light warmth in his eyes.
You are indeed the person I like, and you have lived up to my trust!
It's just that his temper is too twisted.But it doesn’t matter, I have time to train you!
"I'm here! Don't be afraid -" Xia Hou Qingtian pinched Yu Feiyan's little nose and covered her with a quilt.
When Xiahou Qingtian took a shower and changed into clean clothes, a piece of information about Yu Feiyan was already placed on his desk.
Yu Feiyan, the second young lady of the Zhongyi Hou Mansion.
As soon as he read the first sentence, Xiahou Qingtian couldn't help but frown.
If she were of another origin, he could just come and ask for her, but she is the daughter of the Zhongyi Hou Mansion, so it would be a little difficult to force her to stay with him!
The loyal and righteous Hou Yu Jing Lei was brave and adept at fighting and made great achievements in battle. All three of his sons were brave generals who served the country with loyalty and loyalty.
The eldest son Yu Qianxun died on the battlefield, the second son Yu Qianhan disappeared on the battlefield, and the third son Yu Qianxue was demoralized by the enemy general. The Yu family can be described as a loyal family.
If Xiaomao'er is really Yu Qianxun's daughter, the concubine of the Zhongyi Hou Mansion, even if he is a prince, he cannot kidnap her...
Looking down, it records the events of Yu Feiyan from childhood to adulthood.
Stupid? The test results at the age of five showed that her martial arts value was zero. She was a loser who could not condense her profound strength and could not practice martial arts for the rest of her life? A serious illness at the age of seven left her with only the IQ of a seven-year-old child. Is she an out-and-out fool?
